prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on the recent price trend: momentum scores 74 of 100 against the comparison pool. Also in its favour: the share price is 18.5% higher than a year ago; over the past year the share did 20.7 percentage points better than the Nifty 50; and the share price is close to its 52-week high. Other areas on this side: growth, what the price implies, cash flow and the balance sheet.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the balance sheet: profit covers interest costs only 1.2 times; 3 or more is more comfortable. Also against it: debt is as large as or larger than shareholders' equity (debt-to-equity 3.20); the 3-year maximum drawdown was -47.2%, a deep fall; and one-year volatility is 40.1%, high. Other areas on this side: price behaviour, growth, risk.
prose.weighing: Weighing them: 8 points in favour and 6 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 42 of 100. The side that carries most weight is the recent price trend. That gives an educational rating of Hold with high confidence. This is a rule-based reading of the evidence above, not a prediction.
